# Lore

## Key Components

`POST /api/repos/:o/:r/utopia/backfill` (admin) mirrors every document at the default branch's head, then walks commits, issues and pull requests, releases, memories and episodes; the stations sweep `utopia-backfill-tick` (`cron.utopia_backfill.tick`, Sundays 02:30 UTC, delivery held 12 h) posts it for every onboarded repo one at a time over `node:http` with a 30-minute wait (fetch gives up after 5 minutes without headers), skips a 409 repo and stops on a 503. Tests and code have no backfill route: they reach `test-coverage` on the next CI delta.
- `libs/shared/src/lib/path-match.ts` — `allPathsMatch()` minimatch wrapper; returns true only when **every** changed path matches at least one allowlist glob
- `libs/shared/src/domain/pr-body.ts` — `prFooter()` composes…

- [FR7.8 — The sweep posts lore-api's backfill route (FR7.4) for every onboarded r…](https://github.com/re-cinq/lore/blob/74b604ed3edff7b2d4f15b316227e2dac5cf08a9/specs/utopia-graph-mirror/spec.md#L111)

At 11:00:11 the weekly `cron.spec_coverage_backfill.tick` starts about 20 `spec-coverage-backfill` detect runs across all 12 repos at the same moment. Each detect station reads through lore-api over HTTP. The pod's limit is 512Mi (`lore-api-helm/values.yaml`), which gives Node about 250 MB of heap. The crash dropped every in-flight request, so ~10 detect runs failed with `terminated` / `fetch failed`, along with 3 unrelated ingest runs that happened to be running (Otto, lore). Slack reports these as "Unrecognized failure".

Possible fixes, cheapest first:

- Raise lore-api's memory limit (1Gi) and set `--max-old-space-size` to match.
- Stagger the fan-out in `apps/floor/src/work/detect/fan-out.ts`, or cap how many backfill detects run at once.
